title: 2,910 pay responses collected since 2020
summary: Design Pay Asia's community submissions tracker holds 2,910 raw survey responses collected since the project's first cycle in 2020: 1,874 from the 2024 cycle, 450 from the 2023 cycle, and 586 from cycles run between 2020 and 2022 that were never compiled into a published report. This is a cumulative count of raw submissions, not a published cohort. The 2024 report publishes n=1,797 after data cleaning, and the 2023 report publishes n=323. Count as of July 2026.
methodology: Running total of raw submissions to the Design Pay Asia community survey across every cycle since 2020, before data cleaning. This differs from the sample sizes cited in published reports: each report runs its cycle's raw submissions through validation and de-duplication, so the published cohort is always smaller than the raw count for that cycle (2024: 1,874 raw to n=1,797 published; 2023: 450 raw to n=323 published). The 2020–2022 cycles ran before Design Pay Asia published its first report and were never compiled or cleaned, so their 586 submissions have no published cohort to compare against.
